department: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is January 31 for admission; Priority 2 is April 15. The page gives no department-specific deadline.

gre_general.value: Department catalog minimum for the PhD is 304 quantitative plus verbal and 3.0 analytical writing.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Department catalog minimum is TOEFL iBT 80 (internet-based) or 550 (paper-based).

supervisor.value: No official page says a supervisor must be agreed before admission.

funding.value: Departmental funding goes to a limited number of applicants at admission, per the Graduate College.
funding.quote: Departmental funding is awarded to a limited number of highly qualified, full-time students at the time of admission.

entry_route.value: Chemical engineering PhD admission normally requires a bachelor's degree in chemical or another engineering discipline.
entry_route.quote: Admission to graduate study in chemical engineering or biological engineering normally requires the completion of a program leading to a bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or another engineering discipline
